summary: Server singleton: Osiris-issued faction relation changes (ls::Variant alternative 1 of esv::script::RequestSystem's requests), each tagged with the request entity. Filled by esv::script::RequestSystem::ProcessEmitRequests; pushed e.g. by OsirisGameFunctions::SetHostileAndEnterCombat.
